items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Armstrong was playing in Papa Sutterstein's band for a while... Lewis Armstrong was right side of Papa blowing that trumpet.

ctx.x: Do you remember Joe Oliver? Did you ever hear him before he went north? No. No I don't. Or Armstrong did you hear him when you were a kid? You'd be pretty young.
Well I heard Armstrong yes. Armstrong was playing in Papa Sutterstein's band for a while. Oh that's right.
